markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set [F1]; input is blurred and tumor is called at all four margins.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%; others <1% | Dominant single class |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 98th percentile | Not flagged; OOD percentile high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, same top class | Independent check agrees |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Invasive | Mixed; nearest is Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scored low; concept model links this to invasive [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Scored high; concept model links this to less invasive · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score; contributes little · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful. Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Not shown (difference 0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007); leans on Unreliable normal lobules.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) or high OOD percentile (98) distorts embeddings; reliability AUROC is only 0.69.
- Nearest reference case is Benign; only 3 of 5 neighbors agree [F5].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 5, 8** — highest heatmap contribution; confirm invasive carcinoma morphology.
2. **Regions 3, 7** — high gland/tubule scores; rule out benign glands (region 7 invasive score 83%).
3. **Region 10** — lowest margin-strip score (54%, inferior edge); confirm tumor reaches margin [F7].
